"rationale": "A simple mirror only reaches ro≈190k at 80uA and has Vds-mismatch error. A self-biased wide-swing cascode fixes both: a resistor R from iin to the bottom-gate node gives Vgcasc = Vgs1 + Iin·R. That sets Vds1 = Vds2 ≈ 0.2 V, so the matched Vds gives low error. Rout ≈ gm4·ro4·ro2 is in the MΩ range. Compliance ≈ Vds2 + Vdsat4 ≈ 0.3 V. Supply current is 100 µA total, and vdd is unused."}

PARAMS = {
    "gmid_b": (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),     # bottom mirror devices M1/M2
    "L_b":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "gmid_c": (18.0, 12.0, 22.0),    # cascode devices M3/M4 (low vdsat)
    "L_c":    (0.5, 0.25, 1.0),
    "vds_b":  (0.21, 0.16, 0.28),    # target Vds of bottom devices
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iin = spec.get("iin", 20e-6)
    iout = spec.get("iout_target", 80e-6)
    vnom = spec.get("vout_nom", 0.9)
    k = int(round(iout / iin))                      # ratio 4 -> m=4 unit fingers

    vds_b = p["vds_b"]
    # bottom (mirror) devices: unit device at Iin, output = k identical fingers
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iin, vds=vds_b)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_b"], p["L_b"], iout, vds=vds_b)
    # cascodes: source sits at vds_b (body effect included)
    vds3 = max(m1.vgs - vds_b, 0.15)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iin, vds=vds3, vsb=vds_b)
    m4 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_c"], p["L_c"], iout, vds=vnom - vds_b, vsb=vds_b)

    # self-bias resistor: Vg_casc = Vgs1 + Iin*R = vds_b + Vgs3
    R = (vds_b + m3.vgs - m1.vgs) / iin
    R = max(R, 1e3)

    n = Netlist("iin iout vdd vss")
    # input branch: iin -> R -> x (M3 drain, bottom gates) ; M3 gate = iin node
    n.R("RB", "iin", "x", R)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "iin", "y", "vss", m3, m=1)
    n.dev("M1", "y", "x", "vss", "vss", m1, m=1)
    # output branch
    n.dev("M4", "iout", "iin", "z", "vss", m4, m=k)
    n.dev("M2", "z", "x", "vss", "vss", m2, m=k)

    # predictions
    rout = (m4.gm + m4.gmbs) / m4.gds / m2.gds + 1.0 / m4.gds
    # residual error: cascode Vds mismatch reflected to bottom Vds
    dvz = abs((vnom - vds_b) - vds3) * m4.gds / (m4.gm + m4.gmbs)
    err = 100.0 * dvz * m2.gds / iout
    vcomp = vds_b + m4.vdsat
    return n, {
        "iout_err_pct": err,
        "rout": rout,
        "v_compliance": vcomp,
        "power": 1.8 * (iin + iout),
    }
